task/environment/instructions/hireops_rules.md (sections 10 and 12 'Unsent entries'; headings of the rest)
task/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml (header, criterion id list, durability and change-desk criteria)
evidence: Defining behaviour is graded: the coordinated compensation change (saved preview, all-or-nothing commit, idempotent retry) is owned by many functional criteria, e.g. hro_change_net_budget (judge.toml:906), hro_change_preview (:969), hro_change_aba (:1023), hro_change_retry_concurrent (:1050), hro_change_receipt (:1077), plus the offer desk rows (hro_commitment :438, hro_revision_lineage :492, hro_release :546). Durability is proven at each level the brief requires. (1) Server-backed, not merely same-origin: gate hro_gate_shared (gates/constraints/judge.toml:18) and the functional global gate (functional/prompt.md:13) require a UI write retrieved from 'a new independent empty browser context' and state 'a same-context tab/reload or HTTP200 is insufficient ... browser-only save fails'; hro_change_preview_durable (:987) and hro_audit_readback (:834) repeat this for previews and audit lines. (2) Process restart: hro_restart (:897) 'Call restart_app exactly once ... all recorded records/data survive identically, seed IDs remain exactly once', and hro_change_retry_restart (:1122) retries the committed operation after restart; the tool is wired at judge.toml:14-18 to tests/tools/restart_mcp.py, which runs the helper written by test.sh:127-193 against the same database. This matches instruction.md:3 ('including after ... a server restart') and :17 ('retain new work on later restarts'). (3) Reload: hro_entries_reload (:1365) covers unsent entries across a view switch and a reload (instruction.md:9). (4) Re-auth: polish hro_pol_session_resume (polish/judge.toml:27) ends the session, requires a sign-in prompt, hides the entries from Recruiter and restores them for Finance. The brief does not require unsent entries to be server-backed (hireops_rules.md section 12: 'belong to that signed-in person on that browser ... Where the entries are kept is yours'), so no criterion demands it, which is correct. Weak-app check: a localStorage-only app fails both gates; an in-memory server passes the gates but loses hro_restart and hro_change_retry_restart. Conforming-alternative check: prompts forbid assuming routes, engines or schemas, and 'This gate does not infer SQLite from browser behavior'. Raw evidence index hashes all verify (10/10 artifacts, source hashes match the frozen task); live-desk.json records scripted golden observations for reload, session resume and restart. Risk is true only because no full configured judge run exists (index scope: 'Full configured grading/workload ... absent'), so restart_app and newContext under the real claude-code judge are unmeasured. Note, not a defect for this row: hro_restart weighs 0.241 of a functional total of 74 and hro_change_retry_restart 1.0, so an in-memory server forfeits only about 1.7% of functional weight; re-auth durability is scored in polish rather than functional.
